name: salesforce-poc-workspace
description: Salesforce POC Fullstack Workspace: NestJS Backend & Next.js Frontend Console

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix salesforce-poc-be run dev" "npm --prefix salesforce-poc-fe run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix salesforce-poc-be run build && npm --prefix salesforce-poc-fe run build
